title: Zutty's job at the Elite and the Tom Anderson club group
summary: Zutty gave him his job at the Elite on Iberville; he played with Robichaux on the Madison steamer and in Paul's group at Tom Anderson's.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
